name: Morse.pathSpace
why: Both are the maps R -> V that are piecewise smooth on [0,1], with values in N on [0,1], c 0 = p, c 1 = q. The only difference is the formulation of piecewise smoothness (finite break set vs subdivision), equivalent for all paths (isPiecewiseSmooth_iff, copied from item Morse_IsPiecewiseSmooth). Equal sets for all N, p, q.
